latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Government Explainer Video skill.
- Creates plain-language, accessibility-compliant explainer videos for public agencies and government services.
- Helps agencies reduce incomplete applications and repeat contacts by translating complex processes into visual walkthroughs.
- Supports explainer videos for benefits applications, permits, licensing, public health communications, and civic participation.
- Exports videos in formats compliant with government digital accessibility standards.
